title: Uberlândia Weather Forecast: Sun, Intense Heat, and Storm Alert
seoTitle: Uberlândia Weather: Sun, Heat, and Storm Alert Forecast
subtitle: A complete overview of the city's weather conditions for the coming days
excerpt: Uberlândia is experiencing intense sun, high temperatures, and a storm alert. Find out what's happening and how to protect yourself.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Uberlândia is in a state of climatic upheaval: the city is experiencing a day of intense sun and high heat, while Thursday morning has already brought a storm alert with heavy rains and wind gusts. The combination of thermal and precipitation conditions raises concerns for residents and visitors planning outdoor activities.

Sun and Heat on the Weekend

On Saturday (12/09) and Sunday (13/09), Uberlândia will predominantly have sun with temperatures reaching 32°C and 33°C, respectively. The relative humidity remains low, ranging between 40% and 42%, requiring constant hydration. The ultraviolet index reaches very high levels, 8 on Saturday and 9 on Sunday, requiring sun protection.

Storm Alert on Thursday

The National Institute of Meteorology (INMET) issued a storm alert for all of Tuesday (10/09), with a forecast of up to 50 mm of rain, winds between 40 km/h and 60 km/h, and the possibility of hail. The highest accumulation recorded between 7 PM on Wednesday and 7 AM on Thursday was at UBSF Pequis, with 39.6 mm.

Rain and Wind Gusts Spread Across the City

Besides Pequis, the West Sector recorded over 30 mm in various locations, such as UBSF Monte Hebron (33.2 mm) and SESI Mansour (30.6 mm). In the Luizote and Morada Nova regions, the accumulation reached 28.2 mm. Wind gusts reached 36.99 km/h at the DMAE Rondom station in the East Sector.

Precautions and Recommendations

During periods of strong winds, it is advisable to avoid standing or parking vehicles near trees, transmission towers, and billboards. In case of emergency, contact the Civil Defense by dialing 199 or the Fire Department by dialing 193. INMET advises residents not to use electronic devices plugged into outlets during storms.

How to Monitor Weather Changes

To follow updates on rain, temperature, and other weather warnings, consult the Paranaíba Mais website or the official channels of the Civil Defense and INMET. Monitoring the weather forecast in Uberlândia can help plan activities and ensure safety.

With information from Terra, Regionalzão, Paranaíba Mais.
